UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's public profile and subscription status.

photoURL.description: URL for the user's profile picture.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the user profile was created.

subscriptionEndDate.description: Timestamp of when the user's pro subscription expires.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Represents a category or sub-category for content.

parentId.description: The ID of the parent category. Null for top-level categories.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the category was created.

displayStyle.description: The display style for content items in this category.

fileTypes.description: A short string representing the file types in the category (e.g., 'PSD, AI').

order.description: A number used for ordering categories.

visibility.description: Determines who can see the category.

ContentItem.title: Content Item
ContentItem.description: Represents a piece of content with a title, image, and download link or prompt.

title.description: The title of the content item.

downloadUrl.description: URL for the content's download link. Used for style1 and style2.

prompt.description: The prompt text to be copied. Used for style3.

instructions.description: Instructions on how to use the prompt. Used for style3.

videoUrl.description: URL for a video link. Used for style4.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the item was created.

order.description: A number used for ordering content items.

screenshots.description: An array of URLs for screenshot images. Used for style5.

appVersion.description: The version of the application/item. Used for style5.

visibility.description: Determines who can see the content item.

status.description: The approval status of the content item. Items created by editors are 'pending' until approved by an admin.

PricingPlan.title: Pricing Plan
PricingPlan.description: Defines a subscription plan for the application.

description.description: A short description of the plan.

features.description: A list of features included in the plan.

isFeatured.description: Whether this plan should be highlighted.

order.description: A number for ordering the plans.

enabled.description: Whether this plan is active and visible.

link.description: Optional URL for the subscription button.

Suggestion.title: Suggestion
Suggestion.description: Represents a design or code improvement suggestion generated by the AI tool.

inputDesign.description: The design input used to create the suggestion, could be a link, code sample, etc.

inputCode.description: The code input used to create the suggestion.

feedback.description: The feedback provided by the AI suggesting possible improvements.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the suggestion was created.

SubscriptionDialogConfig.title: Subscription Dialog Config
SubscriptionDialogConfig.description: Configuration for the subscription pop-up dialog.

description.description: The main text/description of the dialog.

link.description: The URL for the subscription button.

enabled.description: Whether the dialog is active or not.

ShareLinkConfig.title: Share Link Config
ShareLinkConfig.description: Configuration for the app sharing link.

text.description: The text to be shared along with the URL.

enabled.description: Whether the share link is active or not.

primaryColor.description: The primary color for the light theme in HSL format without the hsl() wrapper (e.g., '222.2 47.4% 11.2%').

primaryColorDark.description: The primary color for the dark theme in HSL format without the hsl() wrapper (e.g., '222.2 47.4% 11.2%').

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Represents a push notification sent to all users.

description.description: The body text of the notification.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the notification was created.

SubscriptionRequest.title: Subscription Request
SubscriptionRequest.description: Represents a user's request to subscribe to a specific plan.

phoneNumber.description: The user's phone number for contact.

planName.description: The name of the pricing plan the user is interested in.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the request was created.

WhitelistEntry.title: Whitelist Entry
WhitelistEntry.description: An entry for a user who is whitelisted for a specific role.

role.description: The role assigned to the user.

activationCode.description: The activation code for a 'pro' user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the entry was created.

subscriptionStartDate.description: Timestamp of when the subscription starts.

subscriptionEndDate.description: Timestamp of when the subscription ends.

isActivated.description: Whether the activation code has been used.

activatedByUid.description: The UID of the user who has activated this entry.

deviceFingerprint.description: A unique identifier for the device used for activation.

PaymentLinksConfig.title: Payment Links Config
PaymentLinksConfig.description: Configuration for payment and contact links.

paymentInstructions.description: Instructions on how to pay and where to send the proof of payment.

PaymentMethod.title: Payment Method
PaymentMethod.description: Represents a payment method button with a name, icon, and link.

name.description: The name of the payment method (e.g., 'PayPal').

icon.description: The name of the lucide-react icon to display.

link.description: The URL for the payment button.

order.description: A number for ordering the payment methods.

enabled.description: Whether this payment method is active and visible.

definition.description: Stores AI-powered suggestions specific to a user. This path enforces user-based ownership.  Includes denormalized `userId` for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns the suggestion.

params.name: suggestionId
params.description: The unique identifier for the suggestion.

definition.description: Stores all categories, including main and sub-categories.
Stores content items within a specific category.
Stores the global configuration for the subscription dialog. There should only be one document with the ID 'config' in this collection.
Stores the global configuration for payment and contact links. There should only be one document with the ID 'config' in this collection.
Stores the global configuration for the app share link. There should only be one document with the ID 'config' in this collection.
Stores the global configuration for the app theme. There should only be one document with the ID 'config' in this collection.
Stores all global notifications sent to users.
Stores whitelisted users by email. Admins can add users here to grant them 'admin' or 'pro' roles, which can then be processed by backend functions to set custom claims.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed for scalability and security. User-specific data like 'Suggestion' is nested under user documents for strict ownership (`/users/{userId}/suggestions/{suggestionId}`). The `categories` collection stores all content sections in a flat structure; sub-sections are defined by a `parentId`, allowing a flexible hierarchy. Content items are stored in a sub-collection (`/categories/{categoryId}/items/{itemId}`), which simplifies querying and enables granular security rules based on the parent category. A single-document collection `appConfig` is used for global settings like theme, share links, and payment links. A `subscriptionRequests` collection stores user requests. A `whitelist` collection is added to allow admins to grant roles to users by email, now including device fingerprinting for security. A `paymentMethods` collection is added to allow admins to dynamically manage payment options.
